svg.aria-label: How HERE works: ReSpeaker to the laptop's speech, sound, attention and context models, through the Vultr relay to the iPhone, the belt and this dashboard, and into Neon memory and Databricks insights

svg.text: Sound becomes direction, words and priority on the laptop; only text and bearings travel; the wearer sees and feels it.

text.font-family: 'Geist Mono', 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, monospace
